snippet.title: Rue Valley Alpha Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Rue Valley ©2024 developed by Emotion Spark Studio. Published by Owlcat Games.

Join Rue Valley open Alpha playtest on Steam! 
Go to Rue Valley store page https://store.steampowered.com/app/2126190/Rue_Valley/ and click on the 'Request Access' button. The game will appear in your library, and you will be able to install it right away.

Wishlist Rue Valley:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2126190/Rue_Valley/
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/rue_valley
EGS: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/rue-valley-48a101

Follow Rue Valley on social media:
Discord: http://discord.gg/UwK4Fw4V7M
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/RueValleyGame/
X (formerly twitter): https://x.com/RueValley
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ruevalleygame/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RueValleyGame
